event GameDeployed(address implementation, address game, address deployer)
event RoleAdminChanged(bytes32 indexed role, bytes32 indexed previousAdminRole, bytes32 indexed newAdminRole)
event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)
event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)

function deploy(address implementation, (address token, address patron, address nft, uint256 nftMinBal, uint256 minAmount, uint256 initPrize, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint32 interval, uint16 betPerc, uint16 refShare, uint16 winnerShare, uint16 nextShare, uint16 patronShare, uint16 teamShare, uint16 holderShare, bool autoFinalize, string uri) setting) returns (address)
function getGame(address gameAddr) view returns ((uint256 gameId, address game, address implementation, address deployer, uint256 timestamp))
function getGameById(uint256 gameId) view returns ((uint256 gameId, address game, address implementation, address deployer, uint256 timestamp))
function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) view returns (address)
function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) view returns (bool)
